function listPosts({url,$}) {return {posts:$("h2 a[href]").map((i,e)=>({url:$(e).attr('href'),title:$(e).text().trim(),publishedAt:$(e).closest('li,article').find('time').attr('datetime')})).get(),next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const title=$("main h1").first().text().trim();const body=$("article .markdown").first().clone();body.find('h1,time,script,style,nav,aside,footer,.toc,.table-of-contents,.post-tags,.post-meta,.post-actions,.page-navigation,.blog-post-title,.title,.upvote-button,.embedded.blog-posts').remove();return {title,bodyHtml:body.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||$('meta[name="date"]').attr('content')||null,tags:$('a[rel="tag"]').map((i,e)=>$(e).text().trim()).get()};}
scraper.notes: 實抓列表 https://kaiblog.is-a.dev/blog 使用 h2 a[href]；實抓文章 https://kaiblog.is-a.dev/blog/bve-studio 標題 main h1，正文 article .markdown。
